purpose: Contextual teaching illustrations, independent of editable algorithm inputs

prompts.rainwater: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: educational illustration inside a dark desktop algorithm lesson, wide 3:2 landscape. Create an elegant miniature architectural cutaway of rainwater trapped between five adjoining vertical rectangular stone columns of varying heights, with turquoise water visibly pooled in the low gaps and a few gentle raindrops above. Side-on orthographic view, precise vertical faces, no perspective ambiguity, solid charcoal #151a1e backdrop blending into page. Pale gray stone, muted turquoise water, restrained lime highlights on the tallest outer barriers. Quiet editorial 3D clay illustration, soft ambient light, crisp silhouettes, generous empty space around the model. This is a physical metaphor for the Trapping Rain Water programming problem, not a data chart or UI screenshot. Water surface horizontal, water only in enclosed gaps above shorter columns, no water outside walls or through solid stone. No text, no numbers, no lettering, no logo, no watermark. Attractive and instructional at a displayed width of 450 pixels.
prompts.house-robber: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: educational contextual illustration for a dark algorithm learning app, wide 3:2 landscape. prompts.islands: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: contextual illustration for a Number of Islands algorithm lesson in a dark learning app, wide 3:2 landscape. A small isolated square board of sixteen equal square tiles in an unmistakable four by four grid, slight isometric aerial view. Most tiles are deep muted blue water. Two clearly disconnected clusters of raised moss-green square land tiles rise above water, one L-shaped cluster toward back left and one compact cluster toward front right with at least a full water tile channel between them. Geometric island coastlines follow tile edges exactly. Clean educational tabletop clay model, charcoal #151a1e background, soft light, pale turquoise coastal edges, restrained lime foliage and a couple tiny rounded trees on land. Emphasize grid adjacency and separate connected land masses. No text, no coordinates, no arrows, no UI, no people, no logos, no watermark. Clear and readable at 450px width.
